verdict.rationale: Docs mention a sandbox environment for testing workflows and code recipes/endpoint examples (e.g., POST /v3/vendors), which supports experimentation, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (like a Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console, discoverable OpenAPI spec, in-browser runnable code examples.
